description: Starter files and snippets for the failed Agent Readiness Grade audits of one store: robots.txt allow rules for AI agents and crawlers, a UCP profile skeleton (or the Shopify setting path), Product JSON-LD with price and stock placeholders, and an llms.txt. Built only from ARC's saved check; each starter is labelled "Starter, review before publishing" and checked by ARC's own validators. Read-only: it does not fetch or change the store, and it never fills in a price. A store with no grade returns no starters.
name: generate_fixes
title: Generate the fix
